# 2 Samuel 2 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Samuel 2 (32 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 11

---

## V.1 — "inquired of" vs. "sought direction"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "inquired of the LORD"
- **PNEUMA:** "sought the LORD's direction"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "inquired of the LORD" — standard rendering for oracular inquiry *sha'al ba-YHWH*.

---

## V.2 — "wife" vs. "widow"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "wife of Nabal"
- **PNEUMA:** "widow of Nabal"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "widow" — Nabal is dead; contextually accurate.

---

## V.5 — "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "faithful love"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "covenant-faithfulness"
- **PNEUMA:** "faithful love"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "covenant-faithfulness" — project convention for *hesed*.

---

## V.7 — "sons of valor" vs. "valiant men" vs. "stand firm"
- **EMET:** "sons of valor"
- **LOGOS:** "valiant men"
- **PNEUMA:** "Take courage and stand firm"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "men of valor" — balances literalism with English. PNEUMA's paraphrase loses *bney chayil*.

---

## V.9 — "Ashuri" vs. "Ashurites" vs. "Asher"
- **EMET:** "the-Ashuri" / **LOGOS:** "the Ashurites" / **PNEUMA:** "Asher"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the Ashurites" — preserves ambiguity of the MT.

---

## V.14 — "play" vs. "compete" vs. "contest"
- **EMET:** "play" / **LOGOS:** "compete" / **PNEUMA:** "have a contest"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "compete" — captures the deadly euphemism of *sachaq*.

---

## V.16 — Place-name: transliteration vs. translation
- **EMET:** "Chelqat ha-Tsurim" / **LOGOS:** "Helkath-hazzurim" / **PNEUMA:** "Field of Sword-Edges"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Helkath-hazzurim" — conventional English transliteration.

---

## V.17 — "hard" vs. "fierce" vs. "savage"
- **EMET:** "exceedingly hard" / **LOGOS:** "very fierce" / **PNEUMA:** "savage"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "very fierce" — *qashah me'od* without PNEUMA's added connotation.

---

## V.22 — Face-lifting idiom
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "lift my face to Joab"
- **PNEUMA:** "face your brother Joab"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "lift my face to your brother Joab" — preserves Hebrew idiom with kinship reference.

---

## V.23 — Spear exit description
- **EMET:** "went-out from-behind-him"
- **LOGOS:** "came out through his back"
- **PNEUMA:** "punched out through his back"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "came out through his back" — accurate without PNEUMA's added force.

---

## V.27 — Joab's oath (*lule* construction)
- **EMET:** literal rendering obscures the conditional
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "if you had not spoken...would not have stopped"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS/PNEUMA correctly parse the *lule* contrary-to-fact conditional.

---
*— SOPHIA*
